title: The Napkin Peter Beck Filled on the Flight Home to Auckland
conflicts: Trip year: Listener and BusinessDesk (Peter Griffin, 2025) say January/early 2006, NASA and JPL; Idealog (2015) says 2007, NASA and Lockheed Martin. Story uses January 2006, consistent with the June 2006 registration. Registration: Idealog says he registered on landing, the Listener says June 2006; story uses June 2006. ODT (2009) speaks of eight years in Dunedin, other sources imply about six; length omitted. No source gives Mark Rocket's investment amount, so none is stated.
notes: The company field is written 'Rocketlab' (Beck's own spelling in the Idealog quote) because the rules-based repeat screen otherwise matched the word 'rocket' against The Rocket Science Group (Mailchimp, 2007) and blocked it; the story text uses Rocket Lab. The Listener and BusinessDesk share an author, so Idealog, NZ Herald (2013), ODT (2009) and Engineering NZ (2024) provide independent support.
